answer: An identity comes only from a sequential time-lock puzzle seeded by the ivory pulse, a signal no one can rush, taking 48 hours on one core; more cores do not help. Puzzles chain per cluster, so identity two takes 96 hours, three takes 144, and so on, with lantern auditors checking proofs at activation and weekly. A hollow claim without sequential work loses the slot. One honest agent pays $25, 48 hours. 100 clones cost 48 times 5,050 hours, 27 years on one rig, or $24,240 at 10 cents an hour, versus $2,500 for 100 honest agents. Scale feels like painting a hundred doors with one brush.
